children: U.S. engineered products maker's Q3 sales rose 10%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose 16%, beating analyst expectations
Company repurchased $352 mln in shares during Q3
Curtiss-Wright raises 2026 sales growth outlook to 8-10% from 8-9%
Company now sees 2026 adjusted diluted EPS at $15.40-$15.60, up from $15.10-$15.40
Curtiss-Wright lifts 2026 free cash flow forecast to $595-$615 mln
AEROSPACE & DEFENSE DEMAND - Co said higher revenues on fighter jet and helicopter programs, submarine programs, and OEM sales in commercial aerospace drove A&D market growth
COMMERCIAL MARKET GROWTH - Higher sales of commercial nuclear solutions and industrial vehicle products supported growth in commercial markets
RESTRUCTURING INITIATIVES - Co said restructuring initiatives and favorable absorption on higher revenues contributed to improved margins
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aerospace & defense peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Curtiss-Wright Corporation is $659.00, about 32.4% above its November 3 closing price of $497.76
The stock recently traded at 29 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 44 three months ago
